title: Wildwood Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 95
rules: If Wildwood has a Tomatometer score of above 95 on Oct 26, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Wildwood premiered at the London Film Festival to a 100% Tomatometer on 17 reviews, with several critics calling it a masterpiece. But a few of those 'fresh' reviews are only lukewarm (for example, IndieWire's B-), the film is long, and early perfect scores usually slip as the count grows to 150-200 reviews. Laika's best final score so far is Kubo's 97% (from memory, not checked here). Staying at 96% or higher needs fewer than about 4-5% negative reviews, which is possible but less likely than not.
blind.falsifier: If the score is still 98-100% with 80+ reviews by release day (October 23), this forecast is too low. If it falls to 94% or below before release, a NO is nearly certain.

leak_matches: odds, even though the film currently sits at 100%

final.reasoning: The market at 71.5% likely knows newer review counts than my 17, so I moved up from 41%. But early 100% scores for festival-launched animated films usually slip below 96% by 150+ reviews, and there are already a few lukewarm fresh reviews, so NO still looks underpriced.
